guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: cartservice logs 407 'FailedPrecondition ... Can't access cart storage' errors that line up with 408 frontend 'request error' lines, and frontend errors rise from 0 to 0.55. Among cartservice's metrics, socket count (+63%, z=+12.66) is the strongest signal; memory (+36%) and CPU (+30%) also rose but much less, so socket is the best-supported fault type, though the digest does not directly show the cause of the cart storage failure.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect cartservice's connections to its cart storage backend for leaked or exhausted sockets, then restart the cartservice pods to release them and fix any connection handling that leaks them.
